name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: Near Ranazjar Isle, Kreldig Ungor still hopes Karnitol's belongings can be found. The Slitherblade naga live among night elf ruins beneath the sea, where Kreldig thinks the satchel is most likely to be.

sections.title: Ruins in the Deep
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor says there is still hope of finding Karnitol's belongings. Farther north along the coast, sunken night elf ruins lie on the ocean floor near Ranazjar Isle. The Slitherblade naga live there, and Kreldig believes it is the likeliest place to find Karnitol's satchel. He gives you a Recovery Diver's Potion.

sections.title: The Stronger Naga
sections.body: Kreldig believes the scouting party that traveled so far south must have been strong. He would search the mightier naga first: the tidehunters and sea witches.

faq.q: Who asks you to find Karnitol's satchel?
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor asks you to find Karnitol's satchel in Desolace.

faq.q: Where does Kreldig think the belongings are?
faq.answer: Kreldig thinks Karnitol's belongings lie among the sunken night elf ruins north along the coast near Ranazjar Isle. The Slitherblade naga make their home there.

faq.q: Which naga does Kreldig suggest searching first?
faq.answer: Kreldig suggests searching the tidehunters and sea witches first. He reasons that a scouting party that traveled so far south must have been powerful.
The second part of the Karnitol shipwreck search came before this.
